AIQIF-C4.1.F1.answer: A 300-hour programme in applied machine learning delivered over two semesters by an IIT continuing-education centre. The attached syllabus covers supervised learning, deep learning, natural language processing, model evaluation and responsible AI, with weekly lab assignments and a capstone project.

AIQIF-C4.1.F2.answer: 28 of our 34 faculty in Computer Science and AI and Data Science completed it in 2024-25, about 300 hours each. Every participant passed the proctored final examination; certificates and attendance logs are attached. The college paid Rs 42,000 per participant, and a second cohort of 20 faculty from other departments started in July 2025.
